decisions.diagnosis: For two weeks the counter also recorded every north-west (46) rider as a south-east (45) rider, so direction 45 is its true count plus direction 46's count; subtracting 46 slot by slot recovers it.
decisions.evidence: Direction 45 was at least direction 46 in all 338 slots where 46 was non-zero from Feb 15 to Feb 28 (normally about 1 in 3, and never above 0.47 in any other week of the record); PM-peak slot correlation between the directions rose from 0.27 to 0.92; the daily 45/46 ratio jumped from about 1.15 to 2.0-2.7 on Feb 15 and dropped back on Mar 1-3; direction 46 was unchanged (21/day PM before and during); 45 minus 46 comes to 54/day (AM 26, PM 8.6) against a normal 51/day (AM 23, PM 9.5); last clean 46>45 slot on Feb 14 20:00, first on Mar 1 14:15.

decisions.diagnosis: Network-wide data outage: the counter reported only zeros (warning-flagged on May 20-25) for exactly a week while riders were using the path, and those counts cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: Both directions 0 from Fri May 19 midday to Fri May 26 ~13:00 after normal 80-110/day; nearby sites 123, 124 and 125 are also 0 on the same days (124 normally 300+/day) and recover on May 26.

decisions.diagnosis: The counter stopped recording for exactly seven days, Friday 10:45 to Friday 11:15 (warning-flagged Mar 20-25), while nearby paths carried riders, so the counts are lost.
decisions.evidence: Both directions 0 between last count at 10:45 Mar 19 and first at 11:15 Mar 26; nearby 193 had 128 and 138 and 202 had 124 and 106 on Mar 24-25, against 122's 0 (normal ~80/day); the flood week (Mar 20-23) lowered neighbours but never to zero, and the clean Friday-to-Friday cut-off matches a counter outage rather than weather.

decisions.diagnosis: A single weekday of warning-flagged zeros in both directions, while neighbouring paths had normal traffic, is a counter or feed outage whose counts cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: 122: 71 on Feb 21, 0 on Feb 22, 74 on Feb 23; on Feb 22 site 193 had 87, 529 had 88, 124 had 775 and 125 had 38, all normal.

decisions.diagnosis: Feed outage: a weekday of warning-flagged zeros shared with other TfNSW counters while nearby paths had normal traffic, so the counts cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: 122: 81 on Oct 22, 0 on Oct 23, 125 on Oct 24; sites 124 and 125 also 0 on Oct 23, while 193 (126) and 529 (119) were normal.

summary: A single MetroCount piezo with a steady record of about 35-55 bikes per direction per day from 2011 to 2026, with one 9-month gap (Oct 2021 - Jul 2022) where no data was published. Direction 45 is inflated for two weeks in Feb 2013 by ghost counts of direction 46's riders, and there are four counter or feed outages recorded as zeros (May 2017 and Mar 2021 week-long, single days in Feb 2024 and Oct 2025), all set missing. The 1229-bike Sunday morning on 2012-10-14 (direction 45 only, 09:00-13:00) looks like an organised ride and stands, as do storm and holiday zero days (2012-06-11, 2016-06-04/05, 2020-02-09, 2020-07-26, 2012-12-25), where nearby counters were also near zero.
